notes.title: Game Release 1st Anniversary!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101986/db7d934ce050a5dd4bd2090fb99e004b10125d67.png"][/img][/p][p]It's been one year since the game's release![/p][p]We look forward to your continued support for Kūsō no Kōbō's works and Aura![/p]

notes.title: Update on February 19, 2025
notes.notes: Fixed a bug and a typo that occurred when the English content was displayed.

notes.title: Update: Support English
notes.notes:
・English has been added as a new supported language.
・One extra still image added
・Full-screen display function added
・Auto-save function added
・Sound effects added when clicking buttons on system screens
・Sound effects added for confirmation when adjusting sound effects on the configuration screen
・Adjusted the background fade-in and BGM when transitioning between title screens

notes.title: Update on October 2, 2024
notes.notes:
Fixed a typo in the in-game text again.
Thanks.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello.
We have released an update that fixes a bug in which certain dialogues of Aura are displayed twice in the conversation part between Francis and Aura in the game.

Thanks!
